summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (between print and print_exception): joins str() of objects with sep, then calls self.print once with emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", crop=False, passing end, style and highlight (default True). Added tests in tests/test_console.py after test_print_style (test_out plus markup, emoji, containers, not-cropped, style, highlight default/None/False, render hook) and a `from rich.text import Text` import at top. Added "Added Console.out" to CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added, and a "Low level output" section to docs/source/console.rst after Logging. Tests were not run, per instructions. Caveats: the highlight tests use "None" (styled by ReprHighlighter) and assert only the presence of an escape sequence for the default case; the render-hook test checks exact output after the hook replaces renderables with Text("hooked\n"). No commits made.
